description: The end user's time zone, resolved once per circuit. AddTempoBlazor() registers it (scoped) and the relative-time formatter, the Scheduler and the Gantt read it by default — on Blazor Server the zone starts as UTC and becomes the browser's zone once the probe reports after the first interactive render; on WebAssembly it is the runtime's zone, which already is the browser's zone. The scoped instance is shared by every consumer, so the browser is read only once per circuit. SetZone lets a host profile setting win over the browser value. The former AddTempoUserTimeZone() opt-in is an obsolete no-op alias since the 2.9.1 default flip.
